# Android notes

* Package id: `com.lastdistrict.game`, ARM64-v8a + armeabi-v7a, landscape (sensor), min SDK 21 (runs on Android 10/11+).
* Built with the prebuilt Godot 4.3 Android template (`gradle_build/use_gradle_build=false`), so no Gradle / NDK is needed.
* Debug keystore is generated by CI (`keytool`) - nothing to configure.
* For a signed **release** APK add these repository secrets (Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions):
  `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64` (base64 of your .jks/.keystore), `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_ALIAS`, `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`.
